correctness.rationale: The product-of-fields annihilator criterion gives weak difference edges exactly for intersecting supports. Every support of size <=3 is an internally complete vertex class of weight product(q_i-1), while size-four coatom classes are independent and each contributes at most one vertex. Any intersecting family containing a singleton is a full singleton star U_i; otherwise all five coatoms are compatible and all triples can be chosen except the complements of selected pairs. Pairwise intersecting two-subsets are contained in a star or triangle, and each pair replaces its complementary triple with signed gain Delta_ij. Choosing positive gains produces the unordered formula. Increasing-coordinate swaps preserve/improve these gains and force seven ordered candidate expressions, including equality/tie and q_i=2 boundaries. Independent finite quotient Bron--Kerbosch enumeration found 81 maximal support families and checked 73 heterogeneous field-order tuples including 1905 at (11,11,11,2,2). Those checks corroborate rather than prove the infinite all-fields claim.
